description: Source code implementing container management classes and functions for the Thunder project, including container creation, starting, stopping, and status checks.

classes.name: CRunContainerAdministrator
classes.description: Manages container instances, providing methods to retrieve and manage containers.

classes.name: CRunContainer
classes.description: Represents a container instance, providing methods to start, stop, and query container status.

methods.name: Instance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of the container administrator.

methods.name: Container
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a container based on configuration files found in search paths.

methods.name: CRunContainer
methods.description: Constructor initializing container with name, path, and log path.

methods.name: ~CRunContainer
methods.description: Destructor that stops the container if running and removes it from the administrator.

methods.name: Pid
methods.description: Retrieves the process ID of the container.

methods.name: Memory
methods.description: Returns memory info of the container.

methods.name: ProcessorInfo
methods.description: Returns processor info of the container.

methods.name: NetworkInterfaces
methods.description: Returns network interfaces associated with the container (not implemented).

methods.name: IsRunning
methods.description: Checks if the container is currently running.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Starts the container with specified command and parameters.

methods.name: OverwriteContainerArgs
methods.description: Replaces container process arguments with new command and parameters.

methods.name: ClearLeftovers
methods.description: Removes leftover containers from previous runs.
